JP.inboundMetricLabel: JNTO visitor arrivals by nationality / country-area
JP.inboundScope: All individually reported countries and territories in JNTO annual workbook; regional aggregates and Others excluded
JP.inboundNote: Definitive 2025 values in 2025 sheet, annual cumulative column. JNTO visitor arrivals include some expatriate/student entry and re-entry movements and exclude crew. Counts are trips, not unique holidaymakers.
JP.label: Official historical travel flows with direction-specific periods

MY.inboundMetricLabel: International visitor arrivals by nationality (tourists + excursionists)
MY.inboundScope: All 45 individually reported nationality markets in Tourism Malaysia KPI 2025 table
MY.inboundNote: 2025 visitor arrivals combine overnight tourists and same-day excursionists. They must not be compared as overnight tourist arrivals. Table row numbers are not rank order; this dataset sorts actual counts. Source published September 2026.
MY.label: Official historical travel flows with direction-specific periods

SG.inboundMetricLabel: International visitor arrivals by place of residence
SG.inboundScope: Individually reported source markets in official SingStat M 550001; includes a combined Belgium–Luxembourg market
SG.inboundNote: Annual totals are sums of twelve 2025 monthly observations. Official data.gov.sg snapshot updated 3 March 2026. Residence is distinct from nationality. Regional and Other-market subtotals excluded. Combined Belgium & Luxembourg has no single ISO 2 code.
SG.label: Official historical travel flows with direction-specific periods

TW.inboundMetricLabel: Visitor arrivals by country / market of residence
TW.inboundScope: Individually reported residence markets; Hong Kong and Macao combined as published
TW.inboundNote: January–December 2025 Table 1-2. Counts include foreign visitors and overseas Chinese visitors. Hong Kong & Macao is one combined source market and cannot be assigned to either territory individually. Regional, Middle East and Other subtotals excluded.
TW.outboundMetricLabel: National outbound departures by first destination
TW.outboundScope: All individually reported first-destination countries / territories in 2025 official table
TW.outboundNote: First destination after leaving Taiwan, not every country visited on an itinerary. All recorded purposes and repeat departures included; the series is not a holiday-only ranking.
TW.label: Official historical travel flows with direction-specific periods

KR.inboundMetricLabel: KTO foreign visitor arrivals by nationality / market
KR.inboundScope: All individually identified country / territory rows with 2025 values in KTO all-country workbook
KR.inboundNote: Annual 2025 values from inbound sheet. Source is Korea Tourism Organization, published 30 January 2026 and subject to revision. Totals include overseas-Korean arrivals separately; region, crew and unallocated categories excluded from country ranks.
KR.label: Official historical travel flows with direction-specific periods

TH.inboundScope: All individually reported countries and territories in MOTS Jan–Dec 2025 preliminary workbook
TH.inboundNote: 2025 preliminary figures from Ministry of Tourism and Sports. Source has 12 monthly columns plus annualYTD; this dataset uses annualYTD and excludes regional and Other aggregates. Thai nationals residing abroad are excluded by the series definition.
TH.label: Official historical travel flows with direction-specific periods

ID.inboundScope: All individually reported country/territory origins in ASEAN Secretariat 2025 submission; not a selected top-five summary
ID.inboundNote: Official ASEAN Secretariat compilation, updated 5 May 2026;2025 preliminary national submissions / national websites as of 28 April 2026. National source: BPS-Statistics Indonesia.
ID.label: Official historical travel flows with direction-specific periods

VN.inboundScope: All individually reported country/territory origins in ASEAN Secretariat 2025 submission; not a selected top-five summary
VN.inboundNote: Official ASEAN Secretariat compilation, updated 5 May 2026;2025 preliminary national submissions / national websites as of 28 April 2026. National source: Viet Nam National Authority of Tourism.
VN.label: Official historical travel flows with direction-specific periods

PH.inboundScope: All individually reported country/territory origins in ASEAN Secretariat 2025 submission; not a selected top-five summary
PH.inboundNote: Official ASEAN Secretariat compilation, updated 5 May 2026;2025 preliminary national submissions / national websites as of 28 April 2026. National source: Philippines Department of Tourism. Coverage may be revised by the national publisher.
PH.label: Official historical travel flows with direction-specific periods

KH.inboundScope: All individually reported country/territory origins in ASEAN Secretariat 2025 submission; not a selected top-five summary
KH.inboundNote: Official ASEAN Secretariat compilation, updated 5 May 2026;2025 preliminary national submissions / national websites as of 28 April 2026. National source: Cambodia Ministry of Tourism.
KH.label: Official historical travel flows with direction-specific periods

LA.inboundScope: All individually reported country/territory origins in ASEAN Secretariat 2025 submission; not a selected top-five summary
LA.inboundNote: Official ASEAN Secretariat compilation, updated 5 May 2026;2025 preliminary national submissions / national websites as of 28 April 2026. National source: Lao Statistics Bureau.
LA.label: Official historical travel flows with direction-specific periods

MM.inboundScope: All individually reported country/territory origins in ASEAN Secretariat 2025 submission; not a selected top-five summary
MM.inboundNote: Official ASEAN Secretariat compilation, updated 5 May 2026;2025 preliminary national submissions / national websites as of 28 April 2026. National source: Myanmar Ministry of Hotels & Tourism.
MM.label: Official historical travel flows with direction-specific periods

BN.inboundMetricLabel: Visitor arrivals by origin country (air arrivals only)
BN.inboundScope: All individually reported country/territory origins in ASEAN Secretariat 2025 submission; not a selected top-five summary
BN.inboundNote: Official ASEAN Secretariat compilation, updated 5 May 2026;2025 preliminary national submissions / national websites as of 28 April 2026. National source: Brunei Department of Economic Planning and Statistics. Country breakdown covers air arrivals only; the broader national total also includes other modes, so no shares are supplied.
BN.label: Official historical travel flows with direction-specific periods

HK.inboundMetricLabel: Visitor arrivals by nationality / region (two-month cumulative)
HK.inboundScope: 20 individually reported markets in HKTB monthly report; additional countries are grouped into Others
HK.inboundNote: Two-month cumulative 2026 counts, not full-year 2025 or November/December 2026. Includes overnight and same-day visitors. Nationality/region replaced residence-based classification after arrival cards were abolished 16 October 2024. Source does not enumerate every country, so these are reported-market ranks rather than a guaranteed global top 20.
HK.label: Official historical travel flows with direction-specific periods

researchNotes.note: The outbound worksheet explicitly notes that destination-country tabulation became unavailable after departure cards were abolished in July 2006. Annual 2025 total 29,550,177 is published, but no 2025 destination-country cells are populated. Do not convert the old country rows into current rankings.

Counts are annual 2025 history except Hong Kong January–February 2026. No profile claims future November/December 2026 measured demand. Country tables preserve source geography and counting definitions. No country-specific outward destination ranking has been manufactured from airport-control-point totals or partial mirror arrivals.
Unstated remains included in the source national total but is excluded from country-market ranks. Growth Rate is a percentage worksheet footer, not a destination.
